source.title: Coder API

authentication.coder: Coder-Session-Token carries a Coder session token for the main API.
authentication.coder_scim: Authorization carries the deployment CODER_SCIM_AUTH_HEADER shared-secret value for SCIM.

source.documentary_posture: Every generated leaf points directly at the immutable raw Swagger document from the pinned official Coder repository commit. The root carries dependencies rather than a second composition.

contract_gaps.protocol_channels: Twenty-one WebSocket, SSE, RPC, PTY, coordination, tailnet, and other long-lived channels require protocol-aware clients and are excluded from finite REST.
contract_gaps.unsupported_media: Binary or multipart request bodies and non-GET binary response bodies cannot be represented faithfully by the current REST composition. Five such operations are excluded.
contract_gaps.browser_auth: Browser redirects, OAuth authorization screens, and callbacks require browser session and redirect semantics and are excluded.
contract_gaps.documentary_auth: Four operations lack a buildable secure static credential channel in the pinned Swagger: one path-carried provisioner secret and three OAuth client registration-management calls without the registration access token header.
contract_gaps.removed_stubs: Five endpoints whose official operation is explicitly named Removed are excluded rather than advertised as live features.
contract_gaps.scim_missing_user: GET /scim/v2/Users/{id} intentionally returns only 404 in the official implementation, so it is excluded as a no-success operation.
contract_gaps.scim_media: Three selected SCIM mutations use application/json request bodies based on the official handlers because generated Swagger omits consumes. SCIM response JSON remains application/scim+json text; the runtime parses only application/json structurally.
contract_gaps.finite_modes: Six admitted endpoints bind follow, format, listen, or wait selectors to finite values and omit WebSocket-only compression controls.
contract_gaps.exact_request_integers: Every admitted JSON body is sent as literal body_raw, and scalar path/query integers are emitted from exact decimal-string arguments. Neither route converts the value through JavaScript Number.
contract_gaps.exact_response_integers: Every admitted application/json response uses unsafe_integers=string so build numbers, counts, timestamps, and other large integer literals remain exact.
contract_gaps.binary_downloads: Four finite binary GET operations isolate bytes into data.file references; their bytes never enter ordinary step values.
contract_gaps.pagination: The suite exposes documented finite page selectors but deliberately declares no automatic paginator; it never claims to traverse an undocumented or endpoint-specific cursor contract.
contract_gaps.dynamic_origin: Coder deployment origins vary. Both per-org connections use an HTTPS placeholder solely as an enrollment example.
contract_gaps.task_source: Coder AI tasks have explicit list/read operations and stable Task field paths. The Source is owner-filtered, read-only, metadata-depth, absence does not imply deletion, and no write operation is declared.
contract_gaps.credentials: Mutations that issue tokens, app secrets, SSH keys, or private credentials always require approval; the two reads whose responses can materialize agent external-auth or Git SSH key material are marked sensitive-read. Neither appears in a bundled workflow.

source_eligibility.evidence: The pinned Coder contract defines codersdk.Task plus list-ai-tasks and get-ai-task-by-id-or-name with stable identity, version, title, state, preview, and hint paths.
Coder workspaces and templates are execution/development resources, not canonical project records with proven project sync semantics.
Chat messages and task logs do not establish a canonical note list/read/version contract in the admitted finite surface.
